children: Shares of Chinese data storage products maker Shenzhen Longsys Electronics (9976.HK) slipped 0.4% to HK$235 following a flat open in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday, after the company raised about HK$7.08 billion ($903 million) in its share sale.
The stock last traded at HK$235.6, down 0.2% from its offer price of HK$236. Hong Kong's benchmark Hang Seng Index
slipped 0.7%, while the Hang Seng TECH Index
Longsys sold 29.99 million Hong Kong shares after exercising an upsizing option. It secured cornerstone investors, including smartphone maker Transsion
